test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the special powers of the Governors according to the Indian Constitution?

A. The Governor of Nagaland shall have special responsibility related to law and order in the State.

B. The Governor of Manipur will submit a special annual report to the President on the administration of hilly areas in the State.

C. The Governor of Sikkim shall have special responsibility for peace and for an equitable arrangement for ensuring the social and economic advancement of different sections.

D. The Governor of Arunachal Pradesh shall have special responsibility with respect to law and order in the State of Arunachal Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is A, C and D only.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Special powers of Governors according to the Indian Constitution:**

 
• **Nagaland:** The Governor of Nagaland has special responsibility related to law and order in the State. This is due to the unique political situation in Nagaland and the need for the Governor to ensure peace and stability.
